title: Dossier catalog and new-dossier creation in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar reading "ANDS Studio · dossier manager", followed by a user chip and navigation chips: "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →". The user chip shows your email and, next to it, your workspace name (drawn from your server account record); the email/workspace is a link to the "Account & security (workspace, MFA)" page, and a "Sign out" button sits beside it. Below, the heading "Your product dossiers" sits beside a "View archived (trash)" button and a "New dossier +" button. An explanatory paragraph states that a Dossier ID "is the permanent file for one product at Health Canada", notes that opening a dossier lets you build its eCTD Module 1–5, and that your workspace's data is isolated from other clients. Several acronyms in this copy (Dossier ID, eCTD, Module 1) carry plain-English glossary tooltips shown at point of use.

If you have no dossiers, a notice says "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission." (While the list fetches, you briefly see "Loading dossiers…".)

Clicking "New dossier +" (the button toggles to "Cancel") opens an inline card with two fields: "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456") and "Product name" (placeholder "Drugazole 10 mg tablet"). Small print explains: "Health Canada issues your Dossier ID when you file a Dossier ID Request through REP (via your CESG account)." (REP and CESG also carry glossary tooltips) and adds "You can set the real ID any time; validation reminds you before filing." A link-style button offers "No ID yet? Start with a placeholder →", which auto-fills a generated ID starting with "d" followed by six digits (e.g. d482913). You then press "Create & open →" (it shows "Creating…" while busy). If your ID doesn't match the required pattern, a red notice appears: "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)".

On success you are taken straight into the dossier's Module 1 workspace.

Back on the catalog, each dossier appears as a clickable tile in a grid showing its ID, product title, a meta line combining its submission type with "CS-BE" (glossary-tooltipped), a progress bar, and a status chip: either "Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules". Placeholder dossiers carry an extra chip, "draft ID — set real ✎".

Renaming and deleting now use in-app modals rather than native browser prompt/confirm dialogs. Clicking "draft ID — set real ✎" opens a "Set the real Health Canada Dossier ID" modal explaining that all documents, sequences and history move with it and that the before/after IDs and your reason are written to the audit trail; it has a "New Dossier ID" field, an optional "Reason for change" field, and "Cancel" / "Apply new ID" buttons. Each tile also has a small "✕" delete button; clicking it opens a "Delete this dossier?" modal that states the action does not permanently destroy the dossier but moves it and all its documents to the archive (trash), where it can be restored with undo, and that it is recorded on the append-only audit trail. To enable the "Archive dossier" button you must type the exact Dossier ID to confirm and enter a required reason; "Cancel" is also offered. Both modals close on Escape or backdrop click. The "View archived (trash)" toggle reveals an "Archived (recoverable)" section listing archived dossiers with their ID, title, archive timestamp, who archived them, and reason, each with a "Restore ↩" button.
